limitations: Real Anthropic calls, source figures, execution screenshots, rendering, and tracing are reserved for parent validation.
The draft buffer and message history are process-local; no durable interrupt/resume, checkpoint, concurrent-user guarantee, or state injection is claimed. U2 follows L10 for those concerns.
Scripted human feedback makes the live demonstration finite and repeatable; take_turn can also be driven manually. It is not a persistent terminal chat application.
Live wording varies. Assertions check state, required facts, tool execution, and exact saved-byte correspondence, not a memorized email.
Offline tests use explicitly named scripted model doubles and do not establish live model behavior.
A four-model-call per-turn budget rejects runaway retries. File-error details are returned as tool errors without false successful-save state.
